title: Last Delivery: a free browser horror game, built with AI assistance
author: SattuStudio
selftext:
I released the first version of Last Delivery, a short horror game about delivering five parcels in an apartment building. A sixth parcel is addressed to you.



I used Codex for implementation and iteration, and image generation for textures, courier sprites and cover art. The game uses Three.js with a low-resolution presentation. Getting the artwork into the game took more iteration than making the images: aligning walking frames, fixing wall clipping and keeping both camera views consistent.



One useful change was keeping the original illustrated courier and cycling walking cels instead of replacing it with a 3D character. I’m still refining the result and would appreciate feedback on what breaks immersion.



Free browser build: [https://sattustudio.itch.io/last-delivery](https://sattustudio.itch.io/last-delivery)
